name: model-router
description: Routes each Oh My Pi task subagent to the smol, midl or slow model role and a thinking level that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. The plugin sends the redacted task text and the agent's description to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description.
